owners.when: /deck/:deckId in slide, grid or book mode
the source drawer is open; delegates to the editor

deck.info.label: Deck info
deck.info.doc: Title, theme, sections with slide ids and titles, counts and the current revision.

deck.create.label: New deck
deck.create.doc: Creates a deck under decks/ from the GT brand template or as one title slide, and returns its id, revision and counts.

deck.rename.label: Rename deck
deck.rename.doc: Sets the deck title, the name the sidebar head, the toolbar and the deck list show; one deck.set of /title.

slide.list.label: List slides
slide.list.doc: Every slide in deck order with its number, section, title, kind and lint counts.

slide.get.label: Get slide
slide.get.doc: The normalized slide, the assets it references and its last render record.

slide.insert.label: Insert slide
slide.insert.doc: Inserts a slide into a section after the named slide, or first.

slide.remove.label: Remove slide
slide.remove.doc: Removes a slide from the deck and its section.

slide.move.label: Move slide
slide.move.doc: Moves a slide to a section after the named slide, or first.

slide.update.label: Patch slide
slide.update.doc: Applies a mutation list to one slide and returns the normalized slide with its findings.

slide.replace.label: Replace slide
slide.replace.doc: Replaces a slide with the given document; what the source drawer’s Apply emits.

block.set.label: Set block property
block.set.doc: Writes one property of a block by JSON pointer; an absent value deletes it.

block.insert.label: Insert block
block.insert.doc: Inserts a block into a slot after the named block, or first.

block.remove.label: Remove block
block.remove.doc: Removes a block from its slide.

block.move.label: Move block
block.move.doc: Moves a block to a slot after the named block, or first.

section.set.label: Set sections
section.set.doc: Replaces the section list, the only place slide order lives.

slide.lease.label: Lease slide
slide.lease.doc: Takes a lease on a slide for the author; another author’s write is rejected with 409 unless forced.

asset.add.label: Add asset
asset.add.doc: Adds a file, a data URL or a fetched URL as an asset with its role, alt, license fields and optional two-tone treatment; returns the asset with twins and metrics.

asset.dither.label: Dither asset
asset.dither.doc: Re-runs the two-tone pipeline on an asset with new parameters and reports plate clearance; with fromRecorded it reads the committed twins back and verifies them cell for cell.

material.capture.label: Capture material
material.capture.doc: Renders a shader material at 3200 by 1800 and captures frozen frames at the given anchors as assets with recipe keys, through the two-tone screen when asked; one anchor returns the asset, several the list.

material.list.label: List materials
material.list.doc: The material catalog: every paper:* entry with its uniform schema and palette presets, and the proto:* engines with their availability.

render.slide.label: Render
render.slide.doc: Renders slides in one or both themes at 1x or 2x and returns render records with image paths.

render.sheet.label: Contact sheet
render.sheet.doc: Renders a contact sheet per theme with a JSON cell map from cell boxes to slide ids.

lint.run.label: Lint
lint.run.doc: Runs the grammar linter on slides in the static, rendered or both layers and returns findings.

fix.run.label: Fix
fix.run.doc: Applies the fix mutations of findings that carry one and reports what remains.

diff.run.label: Diff
diff.run.doc: The mutation list between two revisions in prose, optionally with before and after crops.

version.save.label: Save version
version.save.doc: Saves a named version at the current revision.

version.list.label: List versions
version.list.doc: The saved versions with author, note and revision.

version.restore.label: Restore version
version.restore.doc: Restores a version as a mutation, so it is undoable and visible in History.

view.goto.label: Go to slide
view.goto.doc: Shows a slide in the viewer, the editor or the presenter.

view.mode.label: View mode
view.mode.doc: Switches between slide, grid and book mode.

view.theme.label: View theme
view.theme.doc: Sets the theme of chrome and sheet together through the gt-theme key.

export.run.label: Export
export.run.doc: Exports the deck to PPTX in flatten (perfect, pixel identical) or native (editable text) mode and returns the verified report.

build.run.label: Build standalone
build.run.doc: Writes the single-file HTML deck with fonts and assets inlined and asserts the size budget.

validate.run.label: Validate
validate.run.doc: Validates a deck directory and returns the issues and the normalized document.

source.read.label: Read source
source.read.doc: Glyphfield standard action: the exact current source document of the active owner.

source.apply.label: Apply source
source.apply.doc: Glyphfield standard action: applies a JSON string or object through the active owner’s validator.

controls.list.label: List controls
controls.list.doc: Glyphfield standard action: the visible interactive controls with labels, data-control ids and values.

control.activate.label: Activate control
control.activate.doc: Glyphfield standard action: activates a control by accessible label or data-control id.

control.set.label: Set control
control.set.doc: Glyphfield standard action: sets a form control by accessible label or data-control id.

artifact.download.label: Download artifact
artifact.download.doc: Glyphfield standard action: saves a returned artifact with its deterministic file name.

methods.name: describe()
methods.description: The active owner, its actions and whether source read and apply are supported

methods.name: controls()
methods.description: Visible interactive controls with accessible labels, data-control ids and values

methods.name: activate(label)
methods.description: Activates a control by accessible label or data-control id; RangeError when missing

methods.name: set(label, value)
methods.description: Sets a control by label or data-control id and dispatches input and change

methods.name: readSource()
methods.description: The exact current source document of the active owner

methods.name: applySource(doc)
methods.description: Applies a JSON string or object through the validator, then waits two animation frames

methods.name: invoke(action, input)
methods.description: Runs a standard action or delegates to the active owner

methods.name: download(artifact)
methods.description: Saves a returned artifact with its deterministic file name

errors.name: TypeError
errors.when: malformed input, with the Zod path

errors.name: RangeError
errors.when: an unknown action, label or id

errors.name: ConflictError
errors.when: a stale baseRevision or a held lease, with the holder and the current document attached

errors.name: NotImplementedError
errors.when: an action declared in the table whose implementation lands in a later milestone
